notes: Recall@5 = |top5 ∩ R| / min(5, |R|); MRR over the top 10; P@5 is the citation-precision proxy for an agent that cites the top 5 hits.
R(q) is ground truth from the simulator (planted-event absences or true barrier + language + week); retrieval sees only reply text, metadata and the pipeline's noisy observed label.

dense_hash is a local hashed character 3-4-gram TF-IDF vector baseline, not a semantic embedding model; Gemini embeddings are off by default because of free-tier rate limits (MessageIndex accepts embed_fn).
Queries name the route / section / neighborhood / week, so metadata filtering does most of the work; text-only methods cannot know a reply's route and score near zero by construction.

The cross-lingual barrier lexicon is hand-written and overlaps the template vocabulary of the simulator's reply generator (app/ml/reply_text.py), so cross-lingual numbers are optimistic for real family messages. The '(no labels)' rows show its effect when observed labels are not used.
Weeks are 1-based school weeks (week w = days 5(w-1)..5(w-1)+4); 'this week' is relative to the query's as_of, and replies received after as_of are hidden.
